result.summary: The layout is mostly clean. The main defect is a '−100%' promo badge on the second 'Popular right now' card, which looks like a discount calculation or formatting bug. There is also a possible minor inconsistency in the favorite (heart) button styling between cards.

issues.description: The second restaurant card in 'Popular right now' shows a '−100%' badge. It reads as a 100% discount (free food), which is almost certainly wrong. It looks like a percentage calculation bug or a mislabeled free-delivery promo. The first card correctly uses a descriptive '€0 delivery' badge.
issues.suggestion: Check the discount/badge calculation. If this is a free-delivery promo, show a clear label like '€0 delivery' or 'Free delivery' consistent with other cards. Otherwise show the correct discount value.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons may be styled inconsistently. On the pizza card the heart sits in a clearly visible dark circular backdrop. On the Tokumaru Ramen card, any backdrop is barely visible against the dark image, so the two buttons look different.
issues.suggestion: Give the heart button the same clearly visible backdrop on every card, regardless of the image behind it, so it stays consistent and legible.
